title: Disappointed - slow melting as dish doesn't have a flat flush bottom
text:
Disappointed - slow melting as dish doesn't have a flat flush bottom. Although I was initially pleased when I unboxed this, it has a nice big bowl and is pretty attractive, my pleasure was short-lived when I saw the bottom of the removable bowl/dish. Unlike my other hotplate warmers, this bowl does not have a flat bottom. It has a raised ring around the outer edge which effectively keeps the majority of the dish out of contact with the hot plate.

I feared this would be a slow melter of harder tarts in particular (such as Yankee Candle) and it is now confirmed. I have had a tart on there for over one hour which still isn't melted completely and I am getting very little throw. Very disappointed. I can actually touch the middle underside of the bowl and not be burned, only the raised ring on the outside is hot. I have never seen a hot plate type that had a bowl with a raised ring. I suppose I can use it to melt votives and jarred candles but for tarts it is hopelessly too cool, not as good as my light bulb type melters even.
